chunks: Muhammad b. Ali (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Ali b. Ibrahim narrated to us from Muhammad b. Isa from Mansur from Hisham b. Salim from al-Sadiq Ja'far b. Muhammad (peace be upon them both). He said:

No reward follows a man after his death except in three things: a charity that he established during his life, which continues after his death; a tradition of guidance that he instituted, which is practiced after his death; and a righteous child who seeks forgiveness for him.

key_terms.سنة هدى: tradition of guidance — a beneficial practice or teaching that others continue to follow
key_terms.صدقة جارية: continuous charity (sadaqa jariya) — an ongoing act of charity that continues to benefit others
key_terms.ولد صالح: righteous child — an upright offspring who supplicates for the parent
key_terms.يستغفر: seeks forgiveness — to ask Allah for pardon on behalf of another

ai.seo_question: What are the three things that continue to benefit a person after death according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq states that no reward follows a person after death except for three things: a continuous charity established during one's lifetime, a tradition of guidance that others follow, and a righteous child who prays for forgiveness on their behalf.
word_analysis: may Allah have mercy on him

en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. `Ali (rh) narrated to us. He said: `Ali b. Ibrahim narrated to us from Muhammad b. `Isa from Mansur from Hisham b. Salim from al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad (as). He said:

No reward will follow a man after his death except in three things: (1) A continuous deed (sadaqa jariya) that he had established in his life that continues after his death. (2) A tradition of guidance that continues after his death. (3) A righteous child that seeks repentance for him.
